prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical portrait of a young East Asian woman sitting on lush green grass in a sunny park, leaning beside the thick trunk of a large tree on the right side of the frame. She has long straight black hair, fair skin, delicate natural makeup, and a calm slight smile while looking directly at the camera over her shoulder. She wears a flowing white halter sundress with an open back and thin tie straps; the translucent layered skirt spreads softly across the grass. Her body is seated in profile facing left, knees bent, hands resting near her lap while holding a black smartphone. The background is a bright green park with exactly 3 visible small tree trunks in the distance, dense leafy shrubs, dappled sunlight, and deep natural shadows under the canopy. Use realistic smartphone photography aesthetics, natural summer daylight, high detail in grass and bark texture, soft skin tones, gentle backlighting from the upper left, shallow-to-medium depth of field, candid elegant composition, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Avoid text, watermark, extra people, exaggerated glamour styling, or artificial studio lighting.

promptZh: 创作一张写实风格的竖版肖像，画面主体为 一位年轻的东亚女性，她坐在阳光明媚的公园草地上，身体靠在画面右侧一棵大树的粗壮树干旁。她拥有 乌黑的长直发，皮肤白皙，妆容清透自然，神情恬静，微微带笑，转头看向镜头。她身穿 一件飘逸的白色挂脖式夏日连衣裙，露背设计，配有细系带；半透明的层叠裙摆柔和地铺散在草地上。她侧身向左坐着，双膝弯曲，双手放在膝盖附近，拿着 一部黑色智能手机。背景是绿意盎然的公园，远处可见 3 棵小树干，灌木丛茂密，阳光斑驳，树冠下有深邃的自然阴影。采用写实的智能手机摄影美学，呈现自然的夏季日光，草地和树皮纹理细节丰富，肤色柔和，左上方有柔和的逆光，景深为浅至中等，构图优雅自然，纵横比为 4:5。避免出现文字、水印、多余人物、夸张的影楼风格或人工摄影棚灯光。
